response.text: Several findings so far: journal 1597 is unbalanced, journals 2468 and 2469 were posted after their period's end, and invoice 605 doesn't match its journal. I'll check the AP/GL tie-out more broadly, the duplicate journal pairs, and the closed-period posting rule.

arguments.sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."JRNL_NO", i."INV_AMT", h."SRC_CD", h."POST_DT" FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."JRNL_NO" = i."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IS NULL OR h."SRC_CD" <> 'AP' OR i."INV_AMT" <> (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l."DR_AMT"),0) FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO" = i."JRNL_NO")

SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_CD", h."SRC_REF", (SELECT SUM("DR_AMT") FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") AS amt FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IN (1000,1001,1002,1003) ORDER BY h."JRNL_NO"

SELECT a."JRNL_NO" AS j1, b."JRNL_NO" AS j2, a."PRD_ID", a."POST_DT", b."POST_DT" FROM "GLJRNH" a JOIN "GLJRNH" b ON b."JRNL_NO" > a."JRNL_NO" AND a."SRC_CD"='AP' AND b."SRC_CD"='AP' AND a."POST_DT"=b."POST_DT" AND (SELECT SUM("DR_AMT") FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "JRNL_NO"=a."JRNL_NO") = (SELECT SUM("DR_AMT") FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "JRNL_NO"=b."JRNL_NO") AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "APINVH" WHERE "JRNL_NO"=a."JRNL_NO")>0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "APINVH" WHERE "JRNL_NO"=b."JRNL_NO")>0
